application_event_status_check.name: application_event_status_check
application_event_status_check.value: to_status in ('submitted', 'under_review', 'shortlisted', 'accepted', 'rejected', 'withdrawn') and (from_status is null or from_status in ('submitted', 'under_review', 'shortlisted', 'accepted', 'rejected', 'withdrawn'))

experience_months_check.name: experience_months_check
experience_months_check.value: extract(day from start_month) = 1 and (end_month is null or extract(day from end_month) = 1) and start_month >= date '1960-01-01'

experience_end_after_start_check.name: experience_end_after_start_check
experience_end_after_start_check.value: end_month is null or end_month >= start_month

job_career_stages_check.name: job_career_stages_check
job_career_stages_check.value: cardinality(career_stages) between 1 and 3 and career_stages <@ array['student', 'graduate', 'pharmacist']::text[]

job_salary_check.name: job_salary_check
job_salary_check.value: (salary_min is null or salary_min > 0) and (salary_max is null or salary_max > 0) and (salary_min is null or salary_max is null or salary_max >= salary_min)

job_period_check.name: job_period_check
job_period_check.value: (employment_type = 'temporary' and start_date is not null and end_date is not null and end_date >= start_date) or (employment_type <> 'temporary' and start_date is null and end_date is null)

job_state_check.name: job_state_check
job_state_check.value:
(status in ('draft', 'rejected') or submitted_at is not null)
     and (status not in ('published', 'paused', 'closed', 'expired') or (published_at is not null and first_published_at is not null and expires_at is not null))
     and ((status = 'closed') = (closed_at is not null))

job_application_state_check.name: job_application_state_check
job_application_state_check.value: ((status in ('accepted', 'rejected')) = (decided_at is not null)) and ((status = 'withdrawn') = (withdrawn_at is not null))

job_event_status_check.name: job_event_status_check
job_event_status_check.value: to_status in ('draft', 'pending_review', 'published', 'paused', 'closed', 'expired', 'rejected') and (from_status is null or from_status in ('draft', 'pending_review', 'published', 'paused', 'closed', 'expired', 'rejected'))

job_moderation_decision_reason_check.name: job_moderation_decision_reason_check
job_moderation_decision_reason_check.value: (decision = 'approved' and reason_code = 'meets_guidelines') or (decision = 'rejected' and reason_code in ('incomplete', 'misleading_or_fraud', 'not_pharmacy_related', 'contact_details_in_text', 'discriminatory', 'other'))

organization_audit_role_check.name: organization_audit_role_check
organization_audit_role_check.value: (role is null or role in ('owner', 'admin', 'recruiter')) and (previous_role is null or previous_role in ('owner', 'admin', 'recruiter'))

organization_invitation_email_check.name: organization_invitation_email_check
organization_invitation_email_check.value: email = lower(email) and char_length(email) <= 254 and email ~ '^[^@[:space:]]+@[^@[:space:]]+$'

organization_invitation_state_check.name: organization_invitation_state_check
organization_invitation_state_check.value:
("organization_invitation"."status" = 'pending' and "organization_invitation"."closed_at" is null)
       or ("organization_invitation"."status" <> 'pending' and "organization_invitation"."closed_at" is not null)

upload_state_check.name: upload_state_check
upload_state_check.value:
("upload"."status" = 'processing' and "upload"."object_key" is null and "upload"."sha256" is null and "upload"."reject_reason" is null)
       or ("upload"."status" = 'clean' and "upload"."object_key" is not null and "upload"."sha256" is not null and "upload"."reject_reason" is null)
       or ("upload"."status" = 'rejected' and "upload"."object_key" is null and "upload"."sha256" is null and "upload"."reject_reason" is not null)

verification_decision_reason_check.name: verification_decision_reason_check
verification_decision_reason_check.value:
(decision = 'verified' and reason_code in ('documents_match'))
       or (decision = 'rejected' and reason_code in ('document_unreadable', 'document_missing_or_wrong', 'details_mismatch', 'credential_not_confirmed', 'card_expired', 'other'))

verification_submission_claims_check.name: verification_submission_claims_check
verification_submission_claims_check.value:
("verification_submission"."credential_type" = 'pharmacist' and "verification_submission"."syndicate_number" is not null and "verification_submission"."university" is null)
       or ("verification_submission"."credential_type" = 'student' and "verification_submission"."university" is not null and "verification_submission"."syndicate_number" is null)

verification_submission_state_check.name: verification_submission_state_check
verification_submission_state_check.value:
("verification_submission"."status" = 'pending' and "verification_submission"."decided_at" is null and "verification_submission"."expired_at" is null)
       or ("verification_submission"."status" in ('verified', 'rejected') and "verification_submission"."decided_at" is not null and "verification_submission"."expired_at" is null)
       or ("verification_submission"."status" = 'expired' and "verification_submission"."decided_at" is not null and "verification_submission"."expired_at" is not null and "verification_submission"."card_expires_on" is not null)
